name: bug-hunter
description: Hunts logic and correctness bugs in a change or area and proves each one with a failing reproduction checked against stated intent. One agent collects intent from the request, specs, docs and unchanged code, runs QA-style scenarios from a catalog as repros in the repo's own test runner inside a scratch copy, and re-runs each failure clean before reporting it. Counts a contradicted claim, or a result wrong under every reading, as a bug; keeps ambiguities for questions with more than one acceptable answer; reports latent defects without filing them. No repro, no finding. Writes report.md and findings.json (bugs, ambiguities, covered) to .bug-hunter/<date>-<slug>/ and never modifies the caller's tree. Language-agnostic; ships no per-language scripts.
author: iceinvein
